metadata.title: AMETIS Agent Factory
language.label: Language
tour.workspace.business.title: Your active business
tour.workspace.business.description: See and switch the business you're working with here. The agents and knowledge bases you see depend on which one is selected.
tour.workspace.navBusinesses.title: Businesses
tour.workspace.navBusinesses.description: Each business groups its own documentation, knowledge bases and agents — useful if you manage several brands or clients from the same workspace.
tour.workspace.navDocuments.title: Document library
tour.workspace.navDocuments.description: The active business's source files: upload them here before they can be indexed into a knowledge base.
tour.workspace.navKnowledge.title: Knowledge bases
tour.workspace.navKnowledge.description: Group already-indexed documents, ready for an agent to use when answering questions.
tour.workspace.navAgents.title: Agents
tour.workspace.navAgents.description: Define each assistant's personality, tone and knowledge bases before publishing it.
tour.workspace.navDeployments.title: Deployments
tour.workspace.navDeployments.descriptio: Publish an agent as a web chat or other channel, and customize its appearance (color, logo, messages) from here.
tour.workspace.profile.title: Your account
tour.workspace.profile.description: Change your profile, check your account or sign out from this menu.
header.title: Document library
login.title: Your company knowledge, ready to build agents.
login.description: Organize each workspace's documentation in a secure, traceable environment built to grow.
login.feature.repository.title: Centralized documentation
login.feature.repository.description: A managed repository for every workspace.
login.feature.access.title: Controlled access
login.feature.access.description: Identity and permissions managed by AMETIS.
login.feature.future.title: Ready to evolve
login.feature.future.description: The foundation for configuring and governing your agents.
login.help: Use your AMETIS corporate account. We will take you to the identity service to complete sign-in securely.
login.redirectStatus: Please wait while we connect to your account.
login.error: We could not start sign-in. Check your connection and try again.
login.securityDescription: Agent Factory does not store your sign-in credentials.
register.title: Create your account and workspace
register.description: Signing up automatically creates your AMETIS workspace. From there you manage your businesses, knowledge bases and agents.
register.help: You will need a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
auth.error.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
auth.error.identityUnavailable: The identity service is unavailable. Try again later.
auth.error.registerFailed: Could not create the account. Please try again.
auth.error.loginFailed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
onboarding.title: Create your first business
onboarding.description: A business groups the knowledge bases, documents and agents of a client or unit. You can create more businesses later.
onboarding.step2: Connect Google Drive and set up the document repository
onboarding.step3: Create knowledge bases and publish your agents
onboarding.help: You can change it later from the Businesses section.
error.onboardingRequired: Complete the initial setup to continue.
auth.invalidResponse: The authentication response is not valid.
repository.introDescription: Documents are stored in Google Drive. Indexing and agent association will be added in the next phase.
repository.createDescription: AMETIS will create an identifiable folder and its docs directory in the corporate Drive.
repository.managedPreparingDescription: AMETIS is preparing this workspace's storage. If it doesn't finish on its own, try again.
repository.workspaceIdentityHelp: This is the name your workspace is identified by inside AMETIS. It is set once and shared across all your businesses; each business keeps its documents in its own subfolder.
repository.activeBusinessHelp: Documents for the selected business are stored in this subfolder. Switch businesses from the selector in the top bar.
repository.notIndexed: Files are stored but are not indexed automatically yet.
operation.failedTitle: The operation could not be completed.
drive.connectDescription: Authorize AMETIS to create and manage this workspace's documents in your Google Drive.
drive.notConfiguredDescription: The Google Drive integration has not been configured by the AMETIS administrator yet.
drive.connectedDescription: You can now prepare the workspace document repository.
error.workspaceResolve: The active workspace could not be identified.
error.workspaceMissing: You do not have an available workspace.
error.businessMissing: You have not created any business yet. Create one to get started.
error.businessNotFound: That business does not exist in this workspace.
error.businessNameRequired: Enter a name for the business.
error.businessNameTaken: A business with that name already exists.
business.title: Businesses
business.description: Each business isolates its agents, knowledge bases, and documents from the other clients in this workspace.
business.createDescription: The name identifies the end client. You can change it later.
business.listDescription: The active business determines which agents and knowledge bases you see.
business.emptyDescription: Create the first business to organize agents and documents per client.
business.deleteDialog.title: Delete “{name}”?
business.deleteDialog.description: Its agents, knowledge bases, documents and deployments will be permanently deleted, along with its RAG data. The Drive folder goes to trash (recoverable for 30 days). This cannot be undone.
error.businessDeleteRequiresArchived: Archive the business before deleting it.
error.businessDeleteConfirmationMismatch: The confirmation name does not match.
error.businessRagDeleteFailed: The business was deleted, but its RAG data could not be removed.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
error.operationFailed: The operation could not be completed (status {status}).
error.repositoryNamespaceRequired: Enter a name for the document namespace.
error.repositoryNamespaceTaken: That document namespace is already in use. Choose another name.
error.repositoryNotActive: Prepare the repository before changing the document namespace.
error.documentAlreadyStored: That document is already in the repository (same content).
error.driveProvisioningFailed: The business document folder could not be prepared in Drive. Please try again.
error.storageProvisioningFailed: Document storage could not be prepared. Please try again.
error.storageUploadFailed: The document could not be uploaded. Please try again.
error.storageListingFailed: The documents could not be listed. Please try again.
error.storageDownloadFailed: The document could not be downloaded. Please try again.
error.storageDeleteFailed: The document could not be deleted. Please try again.
error.unsupportedFileType: The file “{name}” is not in a supported format. Select a PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, HTML or URL file.
error.downloadFailed: The document could not be downloaded.
error.driveNotConnected: Connect Google Drive before managing documents.
error.driveOAuthNotConfigured: The Google Drive connection has not been configured in AMETIS yet.
error.driveConnectionFailed: Google Drive could not be connected. Check that you authorized an account with access to the folder and try again.
error.driveStorageQuota: The configured folder is in My Drive. To upload files with the service account, configure a root folder inside a Google Shared Drive.
upload.title: Upload documents to the workspace
upload.description: Drag files here or select them from your device.
upload.constraints: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, HTML and URL · maximum 25 MB per file
documents.title: Stored documents
documents.description: Search, organize and manage the files available in the workspace.
documents.emptyDescription: Upload the first document to start building the workspace knowledge.
documents.noResultsDescription: Try another search term or change the filters.
documents.search.label: Search documents
documents.filter.label: Type
documents.sort.label: Sort
documents.sort.name: Name A–Z
documents.deleteDialog.title: Delete this document?
documents.deleteDialog.description: “{name}” will be moved to the Google Drive bin and will no longer be available in this workspace.
knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.description: Group workspace documents to prepare the context your agents will use.
knowledge.createDescription: Select stored documents and assign them a shared purpose.
knowledge.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what agents will use this base for.
knowledge.documentsHelp: You can create an empty base and add documents later.
knowledge.noDocuments: There are no stored documents to attach yet.
knowledge.listDescription: These bases are not indexed automatically yet; they are prepared for the next phase.
knowledge.emptyDescription: Create the first one by grouping documents by use case, area, or target agent.
repository.nextStep: You can now create businesses and their knowledge bases.
knowledge.deleteDialog.title: Delete this knowledge base?
knowledge.deleteDialog.description: “{name}” will no longer be available to workspace agents. Original documents will not be deleted.
knowledge.deleteDocumentDialog.title: Delete this document?
knowledge.deleteDocumentDialog.descripti: “{name}” will be removed from the repository. This action cannot be undone.
error.knowledgeBaseNameRequired: Enter a name for the knowledge base.
error.knowledgeBaseNameTaken: A knowledge base with that name already exists.
error.knowledgeBaseInvalidDocuments: One selected document is not available in this workspace.
error.knowledgeBaseNotFound: The knowledge base was not found.
agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Define workspace agents and assign knowledge bases to prepare their behavior.
agents.createDescription: Configure the agent's initial purpose and the knowledge bases it can use.
agents.editDescription: Update the agent configuration and publish it again when it is ready.
agents.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what problem this agent solves.
agents.personaHelp: Operational role the agent will assume when answering.
agents.personaPlaceholder: E.g. Senior consultant specialized in customer support and internal processes.
agents.targetAudienceHelp: Primary users the agent should adapt its answers for.
agents.targetAudiencePlaceholder: E.g. Sales team, end customers, or leadership.
agents.toneHelp: Base communication style the agent will use.
agents.responseLanguageHelp: Preferred language when the user does not clearly specify one.
agents.instructionsPlaceholder: Define limits, operating rules, and expected behavior.
agents.suggestedQuestionsHelp: Shown as buttons in the web chat to guide the visitor. Clicking one sends it as a normal query.
agents.suggestedQuestionsHint: Default pool: used on the welcome screen and when the visitor's question doesn't match any topic.
agents.questionTopicsHelp: Group questions by topic. When the visitor asks something, the chat shows the buttons of the topic closest to their question.
agents.questionTopicsHint: Optional. Each topic is indexed to detect what the query is about.
agents.suggestedQuestionPlaceholder: How do I sign up for the service?
agents.suggestedQuestionsOrder.fixed: In the order I wrote them
agents.assistantTextsHint: Override the assistant's generic messages. Leave blank to use the default text.
agents.assistantText.help: When asked what it can do
agents.assistantTextPlaceholder.fallback: I don't have that information. Email us at hello@yourclient.com and we'll help.
agents.assistantTextPlaceholder.greeting: Hi! I'm the assistant for… how can I help?
agents.assistantTextPlaceholder.thanks: Anytime! If you need anything else, I'm here.
agents.assistantTextPlaceholder.farewell: See you soon! Come back anytime.
agents.assistantTextPlaceholder.help: I can answer questions about our services, pricing, and onboarding.
agents.knowledgeBasesHelp: You can create an agent without bases and assign them later.
agents.noKnowledgeBases: There are no knowledge bases available yet.
agents.listDescription: These agents are defined and ready to connect with the AMETIS AI runtime.
agents.emptyDescription: Create the first agent and assign workspace knowledge bases.
agents.deleteDialog.title: Delete this agent?
agents.deleteDialog.description: “{name}” will no longer be available in this workspace. This does not delete documents or knowledge bases.
error.agentNameRequired: Enter a name for the agent.
error.agentPersonaRequired: Enter the agent persona or operational role.
error.agentNameTaken: An agent with that name already exists.
error.agentInvalidKnowledgeBases: One selected knowledge base is not available in this workspace.
agents.publishHelp: Publishing changes the status to Ready and syncs the agent definition with AMETIS AI. Document ingestion will be handled by the indexing pipeline.
agents.indexKnowledgeDisabled: Knowledge is already indexed for the latest publication.
agents.indexingProgressDescription: AMETIS AI is preparing the documents. You can stay on this screen; it will update automatically.
agents.testDescription: Ask a question to validate that it answers using the prepared knowledge.
agents.testPlaceholder: E.g. What does the report propose?
error.agentPublishRequiresKnowledgeBase: Assign at least one knowledge base before publishing the agent.
error.agentPublishSyncFailed: The agent could not be synchronized with AMETIS AI. Check that the RAG service is available and try again.
error.agentIndexingRequiresPublishedAgen: Publish the agent before requesting indexing.
error.agentIndexingJobFailed: The knowledge indexing request could not be created.
error.agentIndexingStatusFailed: The indexing status could not be loaded.
error.agentTestUnavailable: The agent test service is not available.
error.agentTestFailed: The agent could not be tested.
error.agentTestRequiresPublishedAgent: Publish the agent before testing it.
error.agentTestRequiresKnowledgeBase: Attach a knowledge base before testing the agent.
error.agentTestRequiresIndexedKnowledge: Index knowledge with content before testing the agent.
deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.description: Publish prepared agents into consumption channels such as web chat, API, or internal tests.
deployments.createDescription: Select a published agent and define where it will be consumed.
deployments.editDescription: Update the channel, endpoint, or deployment status.
deployments.agentHelp: Only published agents ready to be exposed in a channel are shown.
deployments.noReadyAgents: Publish and index an agent before creating deployments.
deployments.nameHelp: Internal name to recognize this channel inside the workspace.
deployments.channelHelp: Defines the type of consumer that will use the agent.
deployments.channelSoon: Web chat only for now. API and WhatsApp are coming in future versions.
deployments.slugHelp: Unique technical identifier for the deployment; used for URLs, routes, or integrations.
deployments.slugHint: Internal label. The real URL is generated by the platform with its own identifier.
deployments.publicUrlHelp: Address where users or external systems will consume this agent.
deployments.apiKeyHelp: Optional key to protect API consumption or external channels.
deployments.apiKeyPlaceholder: Optional for API or external channels
deployments.apiKeyEditPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current token
deployments.statusHelp: Allows activating or pausing the channel without deleting its configuration.
deployments.listDescription: These records govern where each published agent is available.
deployments.emptyDescription: Create the first channel once you have a published agent.
deployments.deleteDialog.title: Delete this deployment?
deployments.deleteDialog.description: “{name}” will no longer be available as a consumption channel. The agent will not be deleted.
deployments.welcomeMessageHelp: Text shown to the user when the web chat opens, before their first question.
deployments.welcomeMessagePlaceholder: Hi, I'm the AEME assistant. How can I help?
deployments.rateLimitMinuteHelp: Maximum agent queries per minute on this channel. Empty = no limit.
deployments.rateLimitDayHelp: Maximum agent queries per day on this channel. Empty = no limit.
deployments.allowedOriginsHelp: Web domains allowed to consume the agent on this channel. Used to validate the origin of web chat requests.
deployments.allowedOriginsHint: One origin per line (scheme + domain, e.g. https://client.com). Required: with no origins, the web chat won't respond anywhere.
appearance.title: Chat appearance
appearance.description: Customize the widget to match the client's website. Changes show live in the preview on the right.
appearance.avatarHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG · max 2 MB. Used as the chat icon in the bubble and header.
appearance.previewDisclaimer: Visual preview of the theme (color, font, logo). It doesn't answer real questions. To test the actual chat, publish the deployment and use its public link.
error.deploymentSlugTaken: A deployment with that slug already exists.
error.deploymentThemeColorInvalid: Primary color must be a valid hex (e.g. #1e3a8a).
error.deploymentAvatarNotFound: This deployment has no logo configured.
error.deploymentAvatarRequired: Select an image for the logo.
error.deploymentAvatarTooLarge: The image cannot be larger than 2 MB.
error.deploymentAvatarUnsupportedType: Unsupported format. Use PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG.
error.deploymentInvalidAgent: Select a valid agent for this workspace.
error.deploymentRequiresPublishedAgent: Publish the agent before creating a deployment.
